_about: Genre template for the PreToolUse skill gate (skill-gate.py): a phase ACTION in this project cannot run until the skill that governs it was invoked through the Skill tool after the last compaction. Written into <project>/.claude/skill-gate.json by `skills_invoked.py --install-gate --root <project> --genre <g>` at intake (video-production § 1); `genre_overrides[<g>]` replaces `require_any` per rule id for that genre — an explainer renders its own frames, so explainer-video satisfies its finish, designed, cut, frame-sheet, audio and pre-production rules; ads, film and music video use the base lists, or registered in ~/.claude/skill-gate/projects.json with --registry for a tree that must stay clean. Rules match in order, first match governs: `command` is tested against the Bash ACTION text (read-only commands and data heredoc bodies never match), `path` against every target relative to the root; `require_any` names the skills that satisfy it; `scope` = since-compaction (default) | session; `max_age_min` demands a fresh invocation after N minutes; `allow: true` carves an exception. Fix THIS file when the gate denies a legitimate call — never the gate. Rules with `allow: true` (the `probe` rule) carve measurement out of the phase rules; a quoted string with whitespace inside a command is masked as data before matching, so a filename never fires a rule.
